Rice.harvest_maturity_indicators: 80-85% grains turn golden yellow, panicles droop, grain moisture drops to 20-24%
Rice.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest during dry weather using sickles or combine harvesters. Avoid delayed harvesting to prevent shattering and lodging.
Rice.drying_requirements: Sun drying on clean tarpaulin or mechanical hot-air drying to reduce moisture from 20-24% to 13-14% within 24 hours of harvest.
Rice.storage_method: Hermetic storage bags, aerated dry godowns, or metal silos
Rice.suitable_storage_structure: CWC / FCI approved ventilated brick godowns or HDPE hermetic bags
Rice.fungal_moisture_risks: Aflatoxin contamination (Aspergillus flavus) and yellowing if stored above 14% moisture.
Rice.packaging_requirements: Jute gunny bags (50kg) treated with neem extract or multi-layer hermetic PICS bags.
Rice.handling_precautions: Keep bags stacked on wooden dunnage crates 20cm above floor and 50cm away from walls.
Rice.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.7-6.0% overall post-harvest loss during harvesting, threshing, drying, and storage.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR) & FCI Grain Preservation Guidelines

Wheat.harvest_maturity_indicators: Grains become hard and yellow-golden, straw turns dry and brittle, grain moisture 14-16%
Wheat.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest when crop turns completely golden brown. Combine harvesting at 14% moisture recommended.
Wheat.drying_requirements: Dry in thin layers under sunlight until moisture drops to 12% before storage.
Wheat.storage_method: Hermetic grain bags, covered warehouses, or corrugated steel silos
Wheat.suitable_storage_structure: Dry brick-paved godowns with moisture-proof flooring or hermetic Cocoons
Wheat.fungal_moisture_risks: Aspergillus and Penicillium mold growth causing musty odor if moisture exceeds 13%.
Wheat.packaging_requirements: 50kg HDPE woven sacks or clean jute bags stacked up to 16 bags high.
Wheat.handling_precautions: Disinfect storage godowns with malathion 50% EC spray prior to bag stacking.
Wheat.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.5-5.3% post-harvest loss in wheat across farm-to-market channels.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR)

Maize.harvest_maturity_indicators: Black layer formation at grain base, husks turn dry and papery white, kernel moisture 20-25%
Maize.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest cobs when husks turn light brown. De-husk and shell cobs promptly to prevent ear rot.
Maize.drying_requirements: Cob drying followed by grain drying to reach 13% moisture level.
Maize.storage_method: Dry crib storage for cobs, hermetic bags for shelled kernels
Maize.suitable_storage_structure: Ventilated maize cribs or concrete-floored dry godowns
Maize.fungal_moisture_risks: High risk of Aflatoxin (Aspergillus flavus) if stored with >14% moisture content.
Maize.packaging_requirements: Hermetic PICS bags or dry jute bags stored on wooden pallets.
Maize.handling_precautions: Ensure complete separation of infested old stocks from fresh harvest.
Maize.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.6-6.4% post-harvest loss in maize.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR)

Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).harvest_maturity_indicators: 75-80% pods turn brown and dry, seeds rattle inside pods
Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest by cutting plants near ground with sickle. Thresh after 2-3 days of field drying.
Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).drying_requirements: Sun dry threshed seeds for 3-4 days until moisture drops to 9-10%.
Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).storage_method: Hermetic pulse bags, metal bins, or dry earthen pots treated with vegetable oil
Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).suitable_storage_structure: Pucca dry godowns or airtight galvanized iron bins
Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).fungal_moisture_risks: Low fungal risk if moisture <10%; bruchid infestation is main threat.
Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).packaging_requirements: Hermetic Super Grain bags or jute bags smearing with 5ml neem oil/kg grain.
Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).handling_precautions: Sun-dry stored grain every 2 months during monsoon to eliminate pulse beetle eggs.
Arhar/Tur (Pigeon Pea).post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 6.3-8.6% post-harvest loss in pigeon pea due to bruchid damage during storage.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR)

Moong (Green Gram).harvest_maturity_indicators: 80% of pods turn dark brown/black, seeds harden
Moong (Green Gram).harvesting_handling_guidance: Pick pods in 2-3 flushes or harvest full crop when majority of pods mature. Avoid delay to prevent pod shattering.
Moong (Green Gram).drying_requirements: Sun dry harvested pods for 2-3 days before threshing; dry clean seeds to 9% moisture.
Moong (Green Gram).storage_method: Hermetic bags, moisture-proof bins, or sealed clay jars
Moong (Green Gram).suitable_storage_structure: Dry concrete godowns with wooden dunnage
Moong (Green Gram).fungal_moisture_risks: Spoilage and seed coat discoloration if moisture >10%.
Moong (Green Gram).packaging_requirements: Air-tight hermetic PICS bags or gunny bags treated with activated clay.
Moong (Green Gram).handling_precautions: Treat stored seeds with a thin film of edible mustard oil (2-3 ml/kg).
Moong (Green Gram).post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 5.4-7.2% post-harvest loss in green gram.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR)

Urad.harvest_maturity_indicators: Pods turn black and mature, seeds become firm
Urad.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest whole plants or pick mature pods promptly. Thresh by light beating after drying.
Urad.drying_requirements: Dry threshed seeds under sun until moisture drops to 9-10%.
Urad.storage_method: Hermetic storage bags or metal bins
Urad.suitable_storage_structure: Dry ventilated godowns or G.I. storage bins
Urad.fungal_moisture_risks: Mold growth and bean darkening above 10% moisture.
Urad.packaging_requirements: Hermetic grain bags or double jute sacks with polyethylene lining.
Urad.handling_precautions: Store away from damp walls and inspect monthly for bruchid emergence.
Urad.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 5.6-7.8% post-harvest loss in black gram.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR)

Gram (Chickpea).harvest_maturity_indicators: Leaves turn yellow and drop, pods turn straw yellow, seeds rattle inside pods
Gram (Chickpea).harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest plants by pulling or cutting close to ground. Stack harvested crop for 2-3 days before threshing.
Gram (Chickpea).drying_requirements: Sun dry clean chickpea seeds to 9-10% moisture before bagging.
Gram (Chickpea).storage_method: Hermetic PICS bags, metal bins, or dry warehouse stacking
Gram (Chickpea).fungal_moisture_risks: Low fungal risk when dried to 9%; high bruchid vulnerability.
Gram (Chickpea).packaging_requirements: Jute bags with poly-liner or hermetic grain sacks.
Gram (Chickpea).handling_precautions: Mix dry neem leaf powder (1% w/w) with grain during storage.
Gram (Chickpea).post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.3-6.8% post-harvest loss in chickpea.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR)

Groundnut.harvest_maturity_indicators: Leaves turn yellow, inner shell turns dark brown/black, kernels achieve full size with original pink coat
Groundnut.harvesting_handling_guidance: Dig or pull plants out when 75-80% pods mature. Strip pods from vines after field curing.
Groundnut.drying_requirements: Inverted pod drying in fields followed by sun drying to reduce pod moisture to 8-9%.
Groundnut.storage_method: Store in unshelled pod form in dry ventilated warehouses
Groundnut.suitable_storage_structure: CWC godowns with raised dunnage flooring
Groundnut.fungal_moisture_risks: Aflatoxin development (Aspergillus flavus) if moisture exceeds 9%.
Groundnut.packaging_requirements: New clean gunny bags filled to 40kg capacity for free aeration.
Groundnut.handling_precautions: Never store shelled kernels for long periods; store as unshelled pods.
Groundnut.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 6.0-8.2% post-harvest loss in groundnut.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Directorate of Groundnut Research (DGR)

Mustard / Rapeseed.harvest_maturity_indicators: Pods turn yellow, seeds inside turn dark brown/black, seed moisture drops to 15-18%
Mustard / Rapeseed.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest in early morning hours to minimize pod shattering. Stack for 2-3 days before threshing.
Mustard / Rapeseed.drying_requirements: Sun dry threshed mustard seeds on tarpaulin to achieve 7-8% moisture level.
Mustard / Rapeseed.storage_method: Metal bins, hermetic grain bags, or dry gunny bags in ventilated godowns
Mustard / Rapeseed.suitable_storage_structure: Moisture-proof concrete godowns or G.I. storage structures
Mustard / Rapeseed.fungal_moisture_risks: Rancidity and free fatty acid buildup if stored wet.
Mustard / Rapeseed.packaging_requirements: HDPE woven sacks or double jute bags.
Mustard / Rapeseed.handling_precautions: Ensure seeds are thoroughly cleaned of chaff and weed seeds prior to storage.
Mustard / Rapeseed.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 3.8-5.5% post-harvest loss in rapeseed and mustard.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Directorate of Rapeseed-Mustard Research (DRMR)

Sesamum.harvest_maturity_indicators: Bottom capsules turn yellow and start opening, leaves turn yellow and fall off
Sesamum.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest when lower capsules ripen but before top capsules shatter. Bundle plants upright for drying.
Sesamum.drying_requirements: Sun dry upright bundles for 5-7 days; thresh by gentle shaking over cloth.
Sesamum.storage_method: Hermetic bags or sealed metal containers
Sesamum.suitable_storage_structure: Dry cool godowns with wooden dunnage
Sesamum.fungal_moisture_risks: High susceptibility to rancidity if moisture exceeds 8%.
Sesamum.packaging_requirements: Clean poly-lined jute bags filled to 30-40kg capacity.
Sesamum.handling_precautions: Handle gently to prevent seed coat damage.
Sesamum.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.2-6.1% post-harvest loss in sesamum.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - All India Coordinated Research Project on Sesame & Niger

Sugarcane.harvest_maturity_indicators: Brix reading 18-20% with hand refractometer, leaves turn yellow, stalk node buds mature
Sugarcane.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest close to ground level using sharp sugarcane knives. Transport to sugar mill within 24-48 hours.
Sugarcane.drying_requirements: Not applicable (Highly perishable crushed crop). Keep harvested cane shaded.
Sugarcane.storage_method: Immediate mill crushing or shade-covered yard storage for max 48 hours
Sugarcane.suitable_storage_structure: Shaded mill collection yards or open field heaps covered with trash leaves
Sugarcane.relative_humidity_pct_requirement: High ambient humidity to prevent moisture desiccation
Sugarcane.fungal_moisture_risks: Rapid sucrose degradation and acid inversion if delayed beyond 48 hours.
Sugarcane.packaging_requirements: Transported in loose bulk tractor trolleys or truck loads.
Sugarcane.handling_precautions: Minimize time lag between field cutting and factory crushing.
Sugarcane.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 6.5-8.9% post-harvest loss due to sucrose inversion during transport delays.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Sugarcane Breeding Institute (SBI) & ICAR-IISR

Jowar (Sorghum).harvest_maturity_indicators: Grains hard and firm, black spot forms at base of grain, kernel moisture 18-20%
Jowar (Sorghum).harvesting_handling_guidance: Cut earheads with sickle when mature. Sun dry earheads on threshing floor for 3-4 days.
Jowar (Sorghum).drying_requirements: Sun dry clean threshed grain until moisture drops to 10-11%.
Jowar (Sorghum).storage_method: Hermetic bags, traditional underground Khattis, or metal storage bins
Jowar (Sorghum).suitable_storage_structure: CWC brick godowns or G.I. bins
Jowar (Sorghum).fungal_moisture_risks: Grain mold (Fusarium/Curvularia) if harvested during unseasonal rains.
Jowar (Sorghum).packaging_requirements: HDPE woven sacks or clean jute bags.
Jowar (Sorghum).handling_precautions: Store only thoroughly cleaned grain free from broken kernels.
Jowar (Sorghum).post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.2-5.8% post-harvest loss in sorghum.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR)

Bajra (Pearl Millet).harvest_maturity_indicators: Grains turn hard, earheads turn brown, moisture drops to 20%
Bajra (Pearl Millet).harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest earheads by cutting with sickle. Dry earheads thoroughly before threshing.
Bajra (Pearl Millet).drying_requirements: Sun dry threshed grain to 10-11% moisture content.
Bajra (Pearl Millet).storage_method: Hermetic grain bags or covered masonry godowns
Bajra (Pearl Millet).suitable_storage_structure: Dry ventilated godowns or metal storage bins
Bajra (Pearl Millet).fungal_moisture_risks: Rancidity due to high lipase activity in ground flour; store as whole grain.
Bajra (Pearl Millet).packaging_requirements: Hermetic PICS bags or dry jute bags.
Bajra (Pearl Millet).handling_precautions: Do not store milled bajra flour long term; store as un-milled whole grain.
Bajra (Pearl Millet).post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.5-6.1% post-harvest loss in pearl millet.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR)

Ragi (Finger Millet).harvest_maturity_indicators: Earheads turn dark brown, grains hard and brown
Ragi (Finger Millet).harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest earheads in 2-3 pickings as they ripen. Stack earheads for curing before threshing.
Ragi (Finger Millet).drying_requirements: Sun dry threshed tiny ragi grains to 10-11% moisture.
Ragi (Finger Millet).storage_method: Hermetic bags, metal bins, or traditional mud-lined granaries
Ragi (Finger Millet).suitable_storage_structure: Ventilated dry godowns or earthen granaries
major_storage_pest_risks: Very low pest susceptibility due to small seed size and hard seed coat.
Ragi (Finger Millet).fungal_moisture_risks: Minimal fungal issues if kept dry; highly resilient grain.
Ragi (Finger Millet).packaging_requirements: Poly-lined jute sacks or hermetic bags.
Ragi (Finger Millet).handling_precautions: Keep storage dry; ragi can be stored for 2+ years without insect damage.
Ragi (Finger Millet).post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 3.2-4.5% post-harvest loss in finger millet (lowest among millets).

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR)

Sunflower.harvest_maturity_indicators: Back of sunflower head turns lemon yellow to brown, seed moisture drops to 15-20%
Sunflower.harvesting_handling_guidance: Cut heads with 10cm stem when yellow-brown. Dry heads on threshing floor before seed separation.
Sunflower.drying_requirements: Sun dry clean sunflower seeds to reduce moisture to 8-9%.
Sunflower.storage_method: Hermetic bags or aerated flat storage warehouses
Sunflower.fungal_moisture_risks: Free fatty acid rise and seed heating if stored at >9% moisture.
Sunflower.packaging_requirements: Clean jute bags filled to 35-40kg capacity.
Sunflower.handling_precautions: Avoid seed hull cracking during mechanical threshing to prevent oil oxidation.
processing_value_add_options: High-protein sunflower seed meal for livestock
Sunflower.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.1-5.9% post-harvest loss in sunflower.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR)

Cotton.harvest_maturity_indicators: Bolls burst open fully, fluffy white lint exposes
Cotton.harvesting_handling_guidance: Pick cotton bolls in 3-4 pickings during dry sunny weather. Avoid picking immature or wet bolls.
Cotton.drying_requirements: Sun dry picked Kapas on clean cloth/floor to lower moisture to 7-8% before ginning.
Cotton.storage_method: Loose Kapas dry covered yard storage or pressed lint bales
Cotton.suitable_storage_structure: CWC / Cotton Corporation of India (CCI) covered ginning yards & bale warehouses
Cotton.fungal_moisture_risks: Lint yellowing, fiber weakening, and seed heat damage if Kapas stored wet.
Cotton.packaging_requirements: Kapas stored in loose bulk heaps; ginned cotton pressed into 170kg cotton cloth wrapped bales.
Cotton.handling_precautions: Strict fire safety protocols; enforce zero moisture contact in storage yards.
processing_value_add_options: Ginned lint fiber for textile spinning
Cotton.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.0-5.8% post-harvest loss in seed cotton (Kapas).

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology (CIRCOT) & CCI Guidelines

Barley.harvest_maturity_indicators: Grains hard, heads bend downwards, straw turns straw yellow
Barley.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest at 14-16% moisture with combine harvester or sickle. Avoid over-maturity.
Barley.drying_requirements: Sun dry clean barley grain to 12% moisture content.
Barley.storage_method: Hermetic bags, covered masonry godowns, or steel silos
Barley.suitable_storage_structure: Dry ventilated godowns with moisture-proof flooring
Barley.fungal_moisture_risks: Loss of malting quality and germination capacity if moisture >13%.
Barley.packaging_requirements: 50kg HDPE sacks or clean jute bags.
Barley.handling_precautions: Maintain embryo viability by avoiding high temperature hot-air drying.
processing_value_add_options: Malt for brewing & malted food drinks
Barley.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 3.9-5.2% post-harvest loss in barley.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR)

Masoor.harvest_maturity_indicators: Pods turn golden brown, seeds rattle inside pods, leaves dry and shed
Masoor.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest in early morning to prevent pod shattering. Cut plants close to ground.
Masoor.drying_requirements: Sun dry threshed lentil seeds to 9-10% moisture.
Masoor.storage_method: Hermetic bags or sealed metal bins
Masoor.suitable_storage_structure: Dry brick godowns with wooden pallets
Masoor.fungal_moisture_risks: Discoloration and darkening of red coat if stored humid.
Masoor.packaging_requirements: PICS hermetic sacks or clean jute bags.
Masoor.handling_precautions: Clean thoroughly to remove mud balls and broken seeds before bagging.
Masoor.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.8-6.9% post-harvest loss in lentil.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR)

Onion.harvest_maturity_indicators: 50-70% neck fall (tops collapse naturally), outer scales acquire full skin color
Onion.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest during dry weather. Leave 2-3 cm neck attached to bulb during field topping.
Onion.drying_requirements: Field curing for 3-5 days followed by shade curing for 10-15 days to dry neck and skin.
Onion.storage_method: Naturally ventilated Kanda Chawl storage structures or cold storage (for specific varieties)
Onion.suitable_storage_structure: ICAR-DOGR approved elevated bamboo/wooden ventilated Kanda Chawls
Onion.temperature_c_requirement: 25-30°C (ventilated chawl) OR 0-2°C (cold storage for long term)
Onion.fungal_moisture_risks: Black mold (Aspergillus niger), neck rot (Botrytis), and premature sprouting.
Onion.packaging_requirements: Open mesh leno bags (25-50kg capacity) allowing free air circulation.
Onion.handling_precautions: Never stack onions in solid plastic/jute sacks; ensure continuous cross ventilation.
Onion.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET & DOGR estimate 15.0-26.0% post-harvest loss in onions due to rotting, sprouting, and shrinkage during chawl storage.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Directorate of Onion and Garlic Research (DOGR)

Potato.harvest_maturity_indicators: Vines dry up naturally, skin becomes firm and tough (does not feather under thumb pressure)
Potato.harvesting_handling_guidance: Dehaulm vines 10-12 days prior to digging to harden tuber skin. Harvest carefully to prevent cuts.
Potato.drying_requirements: Shade curing at 15-20°C with 85-90% RH for 10-14 days to heal skin cuts and wounds.
Potato.storage_method: Commercial Cold Storage (10-12°C with CIPC treatment for table use OR 2-4°C for seed potatoes)
Potato.suitable_storage_structure: National Horticulture Board (NHB) accredited cold storage facilities
Potato.fungal_moisture_risks: Soft rot (Erwinia), dry rot (Fusarium), and late blight tuber infection.
Potato.packaging_requirements: 50kg mesh leno bags or jute gunny bags.
Potato.handling_precautions: Avoid direct sunlight exposure on tubers to prevent greening (solanine toxicity).
Potato.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 12.5-18.0% post-harvest loss in potatoes across digging, transport, and cold storage storage.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI) & NHB Guidelines

Dry chillies.harvest_maturity_indicators: Pods achieve full red color, feel firm to touch
Dry chillies.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest ripe red pods in 3-4 pickings. Spread harvested chillies on tarpaulin immediately.
Dry chillies.drying_requirements: Sun drying or solar drying for 7-15 days to reduce moisture from 75% to 10%.
Dry chillies.storage_method: Cold storage (4-10°C) to preserve bright red color or dry hermetic bags
Dry chillies.suitable_storage_structure: NHB approved cold storage units or dry ventilated spice godowns
Dry chillies.temperature_c_requirement: 4-10°C (cold storage recommended for premium color retention)
Dry chillies.fungal_moisture_risks: Aflatoxin (Aspergillus flavus) and color bleaching if stored above 11% moisture.
Dry chillies.packaging_requirements: Jute bags lined with polythene or hermetic bags.
Dry chillies.handling_precautions: Protect dried pods from moisture re-absorption and direct sunlight bleaching.
Dry chillies.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 6.8-9.4% post-harvest loss in dry chillies.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR) & Spices Board India

Turmeric.harvest_maturity_indicators: Leaves turn yellow and dry up completely (7-9 months after planting)
Turmeric.harvesting_handling_guidance: Dig rhizomes carefully without cutting. Separate mother rhizomes from finger rhizomes.
Turmeric.drying_requirements: Boil rhizomes in water for 45-60 mins, then sun dry for 10-15 days to 8-10% moisture.
Turmeric.storage_method: Dry polished rhizome storage in ventilated masonry godowns
Turmeric.suitable_storage_structure: Cool, dry, dark spice warehouses or metal storage bins
Turmeric.fungal_moisture_risks: Rhizome rot (Pythium) and mold if rhizomes stored un-boiled or damp.
Turmeric.packaging_requirements: Double gunny bags filled to 50kg capacity.
Turmeric.handling_precautions: Polish dried rhizomes to improve golden-yellow surface shine.
Turmeric.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 5.2-7.8% post-harvest loss in turmeric.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Spices Research (IISR)

Sweet potato.harvest_maturity_indicators: Leaves turn yellow and shed, tubers reach desired marketable size
Sweet potato.harvesting_handling_guidance: Cut vines near ground, dig tubers carefully to avoid skin skinning and bruising.
Sweet potato.drying_requirements: Cure tubers at 28-30°C with 85-90% RH for 4-7 days to heal harvest wounds.
Sweet potato.storage_method: Shade-cured pit storage, raised wooden racks, or ventilated ambient store
Sweet potato.suitable_storage_structure: Ventilated thatch-roofed stores or earthen curing pits
Sweet potato.temperature_c_requirement: 13-15°C (Do NOT store below 10°C to avoid chilling injury)
Sweet potato.fungal_moisture_risks: Black rot (Ceratocystis) and soft rot (Rhizopus) in un-cured bruised tubers.
Sweet potato.packaging_requirements: Slatted wooden crates or mesh bags for ventilation.
Sweet potato.handling_precautions: Never wash tubers prior to storage; clean dry dirt gently.
Sweet potato.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET & CTCRI estimate 8.5-14.0% post-harvest loss in sweet potato.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI)

Linseed.harvest_maturity_indicators: Capsules turn brown and dry, seeds inside rattle
Linseed.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest crop with sickle when 90% capsules ripen. Thresh by beating bundles on floor.
Linseed.drying_requirements: Sun dry threshed seeds until moisture drops to 8%.
Linseed.storage_method: Hermetic bags, metal bins, or dry jute bags
Linseed.suitable_storage_structure: Dry concrete godowns with wooden dunnage
Linseed.fungal_moisture_risks: Rapid oil oxidation and rancidity if seed moisture >9%.
Linseed.packaging_requirements: HDPE woven sacks or poly-lined gunny bags.
Linseed.handling_precautions: Keep seeds dry and dark to preserve omega-3 fatty acid quality.
Linseed.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 3.5-5.0% post-harvest loss in linseed.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Oilseeds Research (IIOR)

Horse-gram.harvest_maturity_indicators: Pods turn yellow-brown, leaves drop, seeds harden
Horse-gram.harvesting_handling_guidance: Pull whole plants when mature. Field dry bundles for 3-4 days before threshing.
Horse-gram.drying_requirements: Sun dry clean seeds to 9-10% moisture content.
Horse-gram.storage_method: Hermetic bags, earthenware pots, or dry gunny bags
Horse-gram.suitable_storage_structure: Earthen dry granaries or metal bins
Horse-gram.fungal_moisture_risks: Low fungal susceptibility due to hard seed coat.
Horse-gram.packaging_requirements: Air-tight PICS bags or jute sacks treated with neem oil.
Horse-gram.handling_precautions: Store in dry airtight containers to prevent bruchid infestation.
processing_value_add_options: Horse-gram flour & soup mix (Kollu / Kulthi powder)
Horse-gram.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 4.0-5.8% post-harvest loss in horse-gram.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR)

Small millets.harvest_maturity_indicators: Earheads turn straw yellow/brown, grains harden (Kodo, Kutki, Foxtail, Barnyard)
Small millets.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest earheads with sickle. Sun dry earheads on threshing floor for 3-5 days before de-husking.
Small millets.drying_requirements: Sun dry threshed grains to 10-11% moisture content.
Small millets.storage_method: Hermetic grain bags, metal bins, or traditional clay granaries
Small millets.suitable_storage_structure: Dry masonry godowns or GI storage structures
Small millets.fungal_moisture_risks: Head smut & mold if harvested in wet conditions.
Small millets.packaging_requirements: Poly-lined jute sacks or hermetic PICS bags.
Small millets.handling_precautions: De-husk small millets using specialized millet de-huskers prior to human consumption.
Small millets.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 3.5-5.0% post-harvest loss in small millets.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Millets Research (IIMR)

Peas & beans (Pulses).harvest_maturity_indicators: Pods turn yellow-brown, seeds become firm and plump
Peas & beans (Pulses).harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest pods when fully mature. Thresh gently to avoid seed splitting.
Peas & beans (Pulses).drying_requirements: Sun dry threshed pulse seeds to 9-10% moisture.
Peas & beans (Pulses).storage_method: Hermetic storage sacks or sealed metal containers
Peas & beans (Pulses).suitable_storage_structure: Dry concrete godowns with wooden dunnage
Peas & beans (Pulses).fungal_moisture_risks: Spoilage and seed splitting if stored wet.
Peas & beans (Pulses).packaging_requirements: PICS bags or double jute sacks.
Peas & beans (Pulses).handling_precautions: Inspect seeds for pea weevil emergence holes before long term storage.
Peas & beans (Pulses).post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 5.0-7.0% post-harvest loss in dry peas and beans.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR)

Other Kharif pulses.harvest_maturity_indicators: Pods turn yellow-black, seeds harden (Cowpea, Moth bean, Rajmash)
Other Kharif pulses.harvesting_handling_guidance: Harvest mature pods in flushes or pull whole plants when dry. Thresh by light beating.
Other Kharif pulses.drying_requirements: Sun dry clean seeds to 9-10% moisture content.
Other Kharif pulses.storage_method: Hermetic PICS bags or dry GI bins
Other Kharif pulses.packaging_requirements: Hermetic grain bags or jute bags treated with edible oil (3ml/kg).
Other Kharif pulses.post_harvest_loss_info: ICAR-CIPHET estimates 5.2-7.5% post-harvest loss in miscellaneous Kharif pulses.

provenance.source_name: ICAR - Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR)
